programs.title: Mere Baap Pehle Aap
programs.desc: Gaurav takes great care of his widowed father Janardhan who has single-handedly raised him and his brother with love. Soon, when Gaurav falls in love, he finds out about his father's childhood love and insists that Janardhan gets married first.
